info.title: reihitsu-format
info.description: Command-line formatting tool for C# source files, powered by the Reihitsu formatter engine.

options.name: --check
options.description: Check if files are formatted (exit code 1 if not); don't write changes

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Show what would change without applying (exit code 1 if changes would be made; cannot be combined with --check)

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show detailed output for each file

options.name: --force
options.description: Skip the confirmation prompt shown when more than 25 files would be formatted

options.name: --utf8-bom
options.description: Write processed files as UTF-8 with a byte order mark

options.name: --lang-version
options.description:
C# language version to parse and format for, such as 12, 12.0, latest, or preview (default: latest)
latest selects 14.0, the newest supported version; newer values such as preview are lowered to it
LangVersion from project files is not read

options.name: --version
options.description:
Show version information
--           Treat all following arguments as paths

arguments.name: PATHS
arguments.description: One or more files or directories to format (default: current directory)
